market_outlook.short_term: Markets face elevated volatility from US-Iran conflict, oil above $90, and global bond selloff. Nasdaq and EM equities under pressure. Rate-hike expectations create headwinds for growth. Energy and defensives outperform. Expect 5-10% drawdown risk in risk assets if conflict escalates further. Dow's 5th monthly gain shows underlying resilience but is likely to pause.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Anthropic, Nvidia 70% growth) and India structural growth provide multi-year equity support. Rising rates and fiscal stress (UK, EM) cap multiple expansion. Energy transition and space economy offer secular themes. Consumer weakness may moderate as inflation cools post-peak. Berkshire's $359B cash signals value-entry opportunity in 6-12 months.
